notes.title: Lentil soup
notes.body:
1. Sweat 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks
2. Add 250 g red lentils, 1 tin tomatoes, 1.2 l stock
3. Simmer 25 min, season with cumin and lemon

Freezes well.
